headline: Contracts for vehicles, wastewater studies, winter road salt, and sewer work, plus two garage leases with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC.
summary: Items cover vehicle and equipment purchases, wastewater studies, winter road salt, and sewer project change orders. Two resolutions would authorize the Mayor to enter garage leases with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC.
